segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ מָצָא אַחַר הַגָּפָה אוֹ אַחַר הַגָּדֵר גּוֹזָלוֹת מְקוּשָּׁרִים, אוֹ בִּשְׁבִילִין שֶׁבַּשָּׂדוֹת – הֲרֵי זֶה לֹא יִגַּע בָּהֶן. מָצָא כְּלִי בָּאַשְׁפָּה, אִם מְכוּסֶּה – לֹא יִגַּע בּוֹ, אִם מְגוּלֶּה – נוֹטֵל וּמַכְרִיז.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» If one «found, behind» a wooden «fence or behind» a stone «fence, bound fledglings, or» if he found them «in the paths that» run «through fields, he may not touch them,» as they were certainly placed there intentionally. In a case where «one found a vessel in a garbage dump, if» it is «concealed, he may not touch it,» as a person certainly concealed it there. «If» it is «exposed,» the finder «takes» the item «and proclaims» his find.

positions.claim: deliberately placed items may not be touched; an exposed vessel in a dump is taken and proclaimed
